questions.q: What does AO2 ask you to do?
options: Refine work by exploring ideas, selecting and experimenting with appropriate media, materials, techniques and processes
questions.why: This is the AO2 wording from the specification.

questions.q: Why change only one variable in each experiment?
options: You can tell what caused the result
questions.why: Changing one thing lets you judge cause and effect.

questions.q: Which is a sign an idea was 'consolidated too early'?
options: Only one composition, no alternatives tested
questions.why: The lowest AO2 band describes ideas consolidated too early.

questions.q: Explain how a student can show 'experimentation and review' in a sketchbook.
questions.model: Try several media or compositions side by side, annotate what worked and what did not, and show a refined next version based on those decisions.
